purpose: State a reason in a formal or literary style.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + ゆえに; N +（の）ゆえに; な-adjective + な / である + ゆえに
I misjudged it because of my limited experience.
I pushed myself too hard because I was young.
It needs protection because it is rare.
formation: Plain clause + ゆえに; N +（の）ゆえに; な-adjective + な / である + ゆえに
restrictions: Often used in reasoning or solemn explanation.
mistake: It gives a cause; it is not the goal use of ために.
